answer_1.quote: We automatically construct unanswerable questions using a Question Generation (QG) model.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the models using the existing BLEU score metric. ... We also propose a new metric called Unanswerable BLEU (UBLEU) ... We use %diff to compute the proportion of generated unanswerable questions that is not identical to its corresponding answerable questions.

answer_4.quote: We recruit four Indonesian native speakers ... Each annotator is asked to give a score to the generated questions with three criteria ... Unanswerability ... Relevancy ... Fluency ...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators score the generated questions based on three criteria: Unanswerability, Relevancy, and Fluency.
